Mercedes 300 SL

https://makerworld.com/de/models/555215-mercedes-300-sl#profileId-473953

a model of the legendary Car

 

Easy to Print. Multicolor

 

use glue to assemble

 

The model has very small detailed parts. Best used for parts 0.12 layer height

 

 

Boost MeYou like my Models, Boost Me :-)

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: 0.16mm layer, 2 walls, 15% infill
- Schichthöhe: 0.16 mm
- Wandlinien: 2
- Infill: 15%
- Filament: PLA (#C12E1F), PLA (#898989), PLA (#FF0000), PLA (#C0C0C0), PLA-CF (#000000), PLA (#FFFFFF), PLA (#000000), PLA (#F99963), PLA (#DCDCDC)
